checks.name: A* matches independent Dijkstra on 80 weighted/blocked maps
Hex lines include both endpoints and use only adjacent cells
Invalid map mask and land are impassable
Friendly crossings are legal; stops on occupied cells are forbidden
An unaffordable destination rejects without stopping at an intermediate friendly cell
Enemy blocks a narrow sea lane, and enemy ownership rejects orders
Shallow-water costs distinguish light ships from heavy ships
Turn rotation refills only the incoming team to 50 oil and increments the round
Movement has no remainder and owner turns refill oil without moving any ship
A failed move does not resume when a blocker leaves or the next round starts
Wait, hold and wake never refund shared oil or individual combat actions
Temporary multi-selection preserves arrival offsets with shared oil and no stacking
Group ships pass a one-cell lane separately without a rigid footprint
Group commands validate ownership atomically and skip held ships without spending their oil
Two and twelve selected ships have no old three-to-six member limit
Box selection accepts every drag direction and includes boundaries
Group movement preserves shallow costs and rejects an isolated member atomically
Asymmetric arrival layouts preserve every world offset across odd and even rows
An island, stationary ship or invalid boundary shifts the entire arrival footprint
A formation too wide for the destination channel fails without changing orders or oil
A short overlapping translation vacates selected cells and completes without stacking
Aircraft preserve arbitrary departure spacing and reach exact translated positions
Aircraft outside the map or with enemy ownership reject before any order changes
Mixed ship and aircraft selection uses one translation and fits all members before moving
Version 7 fleets and future routes are removed without changing positions, oil, HP or aviation
Distant multi-ship moves reject atomically and stay still through save, reload and later turns
Every one of 2 through 8 players has the entire shared roster and unique ship instances
Different ships consume one shared 50-point oil pool in the same turn
Expanded weapons enforce range, armor damage and island line of sight
Defense reduces damage, torpedo cooldown lasts one owner turn, and actions never replenish early
Sinking a selected ship releases its occupied cell without changing other ships positions
Saved game restores independent ownership and resources without persistent groups or ship routes
Distant single-ship moves do not create future orders or spend oil
Version 10 pending ship routes are discarded once while ongoing aircraft commands remain intact
Version 11 rejects removed ship-order fields even when their target is a legal sea cell
Malformed saves reject versions, overlaps, impossible resources and removed group fields
Different players can save and load the same ship asset without sharing resources or orders
Version 1 migration gives the old complete demo roster to its current player and preserves ship progress
Version 2 migration adds full hull, armor action state and empty cooldowns without moving ships
Version 3 migration preserves combat state and replaces per-ship movement with 50 shared oil
CV launches 3x4 and CVL launches 2x3 using shared oil and one action
Launch atomically rejects insufficient oil, inactive teams and held carriers
Aircraft country is fixed to carrier origin, independent of the player owner
Independent realtime squadrons cross islands and pause on other player turns
Bombers strike in realtime, respect armor and defense, and spend ammo instead of oil
Fighters intercept enemy aircraft; non-fighters reject air targets
Automatic fighter range covers both complete hex rings and excludes the third ring
Patrolling fighters automatically attack nearby enemies without pursuing distant aircraft
Automatic fire chooses nearby enemies, ignores friendly aircraft and preserves movement orders
Inactive fighters defend automatically while position and fuel remain paused
Returning fighters and bombers do not automatically intercept enemy aircraft
Squadrons cannot rebase to a carrier from a different country
Recall tracks the moving carrier; low fuel returns and AA causes aircraft losses
In-flight save restores positions, orders, fuel, country, AA cooldown and next outcomes exactly
Low-FPS aviation frames match twenty fine steps and long suspension catches up at most one second
Version 4 migration preserves oil and hull state, removes old carrier strike cooldowns
Version 5 flight saves migrate mixed-country wings to their carrier country without losing flight state
Endurance consumes exactly one turn only when the squadron owner ends their turn
Returning on the final endurance turn recovers to the moving mother before expiration
Version 6 seconds-based flight endurance migrates upwards to complete owner turns
Squadron labels use aircraft category and the surviving aircraft count
Aircraft snap destinations to hex centers and charge one point per adjacent hex independently
Idle aircraft and 2, 4 or 8 player turn cycles never restore aircraft action
The last aircraft action completes exactly one hex then immediately forces return
Spending exactly the remaining aircraft action at a destination still triggers return
Attack approaches charge aircraft action and exhaustion prevents firing or new pursuit orders
Stationary automatic fighter interception consumes ammunition but no movement action
Manual recall spends remaining action before compulsory return and cannot bypass the movement budget
Returning exhausted aircraft cannot replenish in flight; a later new launch has a new budget
Legacy versions 7 and 8 migrate aircraft budgets using remaining endurance without mutating the save
Aircraft spawn at valid hex centers even when the carrier is at a map corner
Air routes cross land but detour around invalid hexes and reject disconnected targets atomically
Aircraft keep asymmetric hex formations when translation crosses row parity
Mid-leg commands preserve the committed adjacent hex and cannot reset its cost or animation
A lost attack target finishes the pending hex then idles without freezing the flight animation
Partial hex travel is preserved through player transitions and a saved game
Version 9 free-flight saves snap to hexes and floor fractional budgets once without refilling
Malformed aviation saves reject identity, ownership, timing, slot and command corruption
